entries.07ae2d1d3660f478: This equipment processes captured images with AI (artificial intelligence) and can automatically detect surface scratches, stains and similar flaws. It is also offered as a system combined with a robot that picks up the objects being measured and transports them to the inspection equipment.
entries.0b4e9fe2cfb33269: A company that develops, manufactures and sells precision equipment such as precision vibration isolation devices and gear testers, centered on light source devices for inspecting image sensors.
entries.1ff2ceefebae3292: This business develops, manufactures and sells inspection light source equipment and pupil modules, among others, used in the manufacturing process of imaging semiconductors (CCD and CMOS image sensors).
entries.2adb4cf38245aff6: This business develops, manufactures and sells precision vibration isolation equipment and other products, contact-type inspection equipment essential to gear manufacturing, provides development support for business systems, and develops, manufactures and sells AI image processing equipment and laser processing machines.
entries.2b2f289d6cd48ca1: This equipment removes vibration and is needed for optical experiments using lasers and for exposure equipment that prints circuits of liquid crystal and semiconductor devices, among others. It has also commercialized a vibration monitoring app that visualizes vibration and vibration excitation equipment that precisely reproduces customers' vibration environments.
entries.5cf32906cc197316: This module achieves optical characteristics equal to or better than those of the camera module used in the final application during the wafer inspection process of image sensors, enabling defect detection in the initial test process.
entries.7080bd09ac465575: This business develops, manufactures and sells inspection light source equipment and pupil modules, among others, used in the manufacturing process of imaging semiconductors (CCD and CMOS image sensors). The company itself (the filing company) handles this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥2,952 million.
entries.7246de390639c987: This is a business segment not included in reportable segments. Because the company transferred all shares of Air Gases Technos Co., Ltd., formerly a consolidated subsidiary, on July 2, 2025, and excluded it from the scope of consolidation, the “Environmental Energy Business,” whose main component had been that company's business, was excluded from reportable segments from the current consolidated fiscal year and is shown as “Other.” Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥9 million.

entries.974fd29ba170c779: This equipment generates the light needed to test CCD and CMOS image sensors for pass/fail judgment, and irradiates the inspection target with that light at high precision and high speed. entries.a05de80eb0a6fe60: This equipment can process materials with high processing difficulty, such as those used in next-generation semiconductors, that are difficult to handle mainly with mechanical processing.
